steps.tx: Every replication drug exploits a fidelity or supply asymmetry: cancer and viruses copy faster, with leakier checkpoints, than host marrow and gut which pay dose limiting toxicity in the same currency. **Chain terminators** (acyclovir, zidovudine, cytarabine arabinose sugar, gemcitabine difluoro cytidine with masked phosphorylation and reductase self potentiation) incorporate then halt extension for lack of three prime hydroxyl or by distortion, selectivity coming from activation kinases, polymerase preference and repair differences already layered in prior lessons.
steps.say: Replication drugs exploit faster copying with leakier checkpoints in cancer and viruses. Chain terminators halt extension after incorporation, with selectivity from activation kinases and polymerase preference differences layered previously.

steps.tx: **Topoisomerase poisons** convert essential enzymes into DNA breaking toxins: camptothecins (irinotecan SN-38 UGT1A1 Gilbert toxicity, topotecan) trap topoisomerase I single strand cleavage (S phase collision doubles damage), etoposide and anthracyclines trap topoisomerase II double strand complexes (anthracyclines add intercalation, redox quinone cardiotoxicity cumulative dexrazoxane protected, secondary leukaemias with balanced translocations as class cost), fluoroquinolones trap bacterial gyrase and topoisomerase IV selectively (achilles tendinopathy, QT, dysglycaemia cautions). Inhibitors that merely block catalysis (dexrazoxane catalytic) behave oppositely to poisons that trap complexes, vocabulary precision examiners enforce.
steps.say: Topoisomerase poisons trap cleavage complexes as DNA breaking toxins in S phase collisions lethally. Catalytic inhibitors behave oppositely to poisons, vocabulary precision examiners enforce strictly in pharmacology distinctions.

steps.tx: **Cell cycle phase** specificity predicts combinations and toxicities: S phase agents (antimetabolites, camptothecins) kill copying fractions (marrow nadirs days seven to fourteen, mucositis, alopecia by proliferation geography), M phase spindle poisons (vincristine tubulin depolymerisation capped, taxanes stabilisation, peripheral neuropathy and marrow patterns swapped characteristically (vincristine spares marrow relatively)), G1 CDK4/6 inhibitors (palbociclib cytostatic in Rb intact breast cancer) and radiation (double breaks, oxygen enhancement, fractionation repair windows) sequencing with repair inhibitors (PARP, ATR investigational) as modern synthetic lethality trial logic.
steps.say: Phase specificity predicts combinations and toxicities across marrow nadirs and mucositis geography patterns. CDK inhibitors and radiation sequencing with repair inhibitors form modern synthetic lethality trial logic currently.
